content.comment_body: When I log into the webserver to operate [product_name], the session disconnects after pressing just a few buttons. Why is it unstable? I would like to remain logged in for extended periods. Thank you for sharing your expertise.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are facing frequent disconnections when using the webserver interface to control [product_name], especially after minimal interaction. This unstable behavior prevents efficient long-term use, causing frustration regarding session persistence.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect reliable, continuous access to the webserver to enable uninterrupted operation of [product_name] without unexpected logouts.
